description: Close a point of sale permanently. Takes the outlet id from get_outlets. CONFIRM WITH THE MERCHANT FIRST, naming the outlet — there is NO undo from here. Tell them what goes with it: the stock recorded AT that outlet is removed and is NOT moved anywhere else (transfer it out first if they want to keep it), and so are the outlet’s tax rate values and its per-outlet product visibility. Past orders, sessions and reports still name the outlet and are not touched, and the stations that belonged to it are NOT deleted — they have to be dealt with separately. An outlet that WooCommerce uses as its default is refused: the merchant must change that default or uninstall the WooCommerce extension first.

outletId.description: Outlet id from get_outlets — not a name

name: hub_delete_outlet
title: Delete outlet
